articles.summary: - FDA STAR pilot program aims to shorten the time from complete supplement submission to the action date to allow earlier patient access to therapies that address an unmet medical need PASADENA, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 7, 2026-- Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
articles.title: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Granted Entry in the FDA STAR Pilot Program for Plozasiran in Severe Hypertriglyceridemia
